$comment: The Claude-Code plugin shelf — a CC-compatible marketplace manifest (schema: {name, plugins:[{name, source, description, version, commands}]}). navig's plugin host (core/navig/plugins/marketplace.py -> fetch_marketplace) reads THIS file. This `plugins` array is ONLY for GIT-installable Claude-Code-compatible plugins (a repo whose root has .claude-plugin/plugin.json, installed via `navig store install <git-url>`). It is kept empty rather than listing pip/npm packages, because a git install does a git-clone + dir-copy and cannot install a pip/npm distribution — a listed pip/npm entry would fail at install time. First-party pip/npm plugins are indexed in registry/plugins/registry.json instead (generated by scripts/gen_plugin_registry.py), which community.yaml's `plugins` pillar now points at; that index records real availability, so it never advertises an install command for a package that is not on the index. Add an entry here (with a full https:// source) only when a real git-installable CC plugin ships. Keep it a plain array with ONLY CC-standard fields so Claude Code can consume this file unchanged.
name: navig-registry

metadata.description: Git-installable Claude-Code-compatible NAVIG plugins. (First-party plugins install via pip/npm — see $comment.)
